symbolic.scope: Symbolic identities and arithmetic checks support the written all-size proof. The massless coefficient limit does not extend the positive-mass remainder theorem to zero mass.

quadrature.scope: Sampled checks of exact quadrature identities and the bound. The written Euler-Maclaurin estimate, not these samples, proves uniformity in size and time.

complete_integral.scope: Every massive mode is included in both independent calculations; no spectral window or zero-mode subtraction is used.

radius_variations.scope: Collective integer refinement steps grow while their relative size shrinks. These are not derivatives of an action with its two representation sizes held fixed.

constant_volume_profiles.scope: Each scale has exactly fixed total volume and field dimension across shapes; the factor representation sizes are redistributed.

constant_volume_fourth_variations.scope: Uniform action errors divided by K^2 h^4 vanish on this exact integer stencil. This justifies finite shape variations through fourth order, but supplies no local microscopic transition law.

fixed_size_control.scope: The same common positive mass does not fix the leading shape mismatch if both matrix sizes are held fixed. This isolates the effect of the supplied proper-resolution rule.

coordinate_localization.scope: With fixed spectral cutoff, coherent-state position variance grows as radius/cutoff. This obstructs treating spectral density alone as a proof of uniform matrix-product locality; it is not a no-go for every observable algebra or a failure of the free determinant theorem.

scope: At fixed positive common mass and proper cutoff, the complete balanced determinant has the Einstein leading curvature functional with a uniformly bounded remainder on bounded-aspect product spheres. Exact-volume refinement stencils recover its second and fourth shape variations. The resolution rule, matrix geometry, matter balance, common mass and measure are supplied. No arbitrary-metric action, local refinement Hamiltonian, Lorentzian gravitational phase, Einstein constraint algebra, Standard Model recovery or TOE is proved; there is no new Lean theorem.
